name: What should I consider when hiring a contractor for paver installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when hiring a contractor for paver installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a paver installation contractor, prioritize experience, reputation, and proper licensing. Look for a contractor with a proven track record in paver projects, evidenced by a portfolio of completed work and positive client testimonials. Ensure they are fully licensed, insured, and can provide a detailed, written quote outlining all costs and project timelines. Communication is key; choose a contractor who is responsive and transparent throughout the process to ensure your vision is realized.
acceptedAnswer.description: When hiring, consider the contractor's experience, reputation, licensing, insurance, detailed quotes, and clear communication.
